The '''Ultragungan Lair''' was a bunker controlled by a group of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] known as the [[Ultragungans|Ultragungan Militia]]. It was located in the [[Lasay Swamp]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
[[File:UltraGunanLair2.jpg|200px|thumb|Derelict droids in the Ultragungan Lair]]
The [[Ultragungans|Ultragungan]] Lair was a bunker in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. It was situated on a small island on the Lasay Swamp region of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world of Naboo. Controlled by a group of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] known as the Ultragungans, the lair was filled with a security force of numerous flawed [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], including [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[blastromech droid]]s, and a single [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMTGBD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer raided the bunker in order to recover an experimental [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] droid module: a [[stochastic decision chip]]. Thanks to the help of the Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], the spacer was able to access to the bunker and find the super battle droid that contained the droid module without triggering the self-destruct security mechanism.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTGBD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ultragungan Lair appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ORDMTGBD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Ultragungan Lair was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
